scope: Python consumer schema evaluation methods and generic interpreter branch control; ordinary Value/wire/resource admission unchanged

modes.FirstError: Stop at the first publicly surfaced validation error; use for is_valid and validate and native predicate subcalls. Never execute an unneeded later arithmetic operation.
modes.AllErrors: Collect ordered publicly yieldable error prefix. Preserve an approved PYTHON_SCHEMA_ARITHMETIC terminal error after that prefix.

api.operationalErrors: LIMIT, cancellation, deadline, clock, meter and other operational failures remain outer Err and always propagate. They are never deferred or converted to validation false.
api.pythonFacade: iter_errors returns a generator without evaluating at construction. On iteration, yield native-ordered public diagnostics, then raise the deferred approved arithmetic UmfCoreError when reached. validate raises the first _NativeSchemaError or arithmetic UmfCoreError; is_valid returns false at the first validation error.

combinatorRules: anyOf and oneOf buffer candidate descend errors internally; they do not expose those candidate diagnostics as the public prefix. Preserve native first-success and remaining-predicate behavior.
allOf, properties and items propagate publicly yieldable child errors in order before a later arithmetic failure.
not, if and contains use native first-error predicate behavior; do not globally suppress arithmetic errors merely because some branch was invalid.
unevaluatedProperties/items annotation collection can require evaluating branches beyond the first successful anyOf. Preserve this native behavior; no blanket anyOf branch suppression.
Preserve declared dialect keyword identity, including Draft3 divisibleBy diagnostic keyword and schema path.
compatibilityQualification: Native arithmetic exception classes/messages remain immutable oracle provenance. Candidate arithmetic errors follow R2-SOL-PYTHON-SCHEMA-ARITHMETIC-001 stable PYTHON_SCHEMA_ARITHMETIC/UmfCoreError mapping. Existing candidate normalized validation error envelope is retained; keyword and native code-point instance/schema paths preserve their meaning.
implementationRequirements: Use one generic Rust evaluator and explicit evaluation modes; no Python/JavaScript semantic fallback.
Preserve trusted source-origin metadata in diagnostics and deferred errors.
Meter owned prefix/error copies and branch buffers before allocation and keep operation controls within Rust.
Do not change any frozen predecessor expected records.
